study_identification.author_journal_year: Zhang et al., Journal of Affective Disorders, 2023
study_identification.title: Parsing the heterogeneity of brain-symptom associations in autism spectrum disorder via random forest with homogeneous canonical correlation

study_characteristics.study_objective: Build a normative model of regional GMV in controls to quantify per-case deviations in ASD, then identify ASD subtypes based on homogeneous multivariate brain–symptom association patterns and test whether subtyping improves case–control classification.

clinical_application_and_analysis.association_analysis: CCA between volumetric deviations (140 ROIs) and ADOS subscales; homogeneity index via split-half permutations to define stable CCA modes; subtype discovery via RFHCC using SVD-derived PCs as grouping features; case–control classification AUC with matched controls (EGMAD and R ‘matchit’: optimal/knn/cardinality), 60/40 train/test repeated 100×; permutation testing (1000 shuffles) and feature importance via python ‘eli5’ with 5-fold CV.
clinical_application_and_analysis.key_findings_brief: Identified four ASD subtypes with distinct brain–symptom association patterns; subtyping improved case–control AUC from 0.64 (no subtyping) to 0.75 (p<0.05), outperforming k-means subtyping (AUC 0.68).
clinical_application_and_analysis.key_findings_detailed: Using the normative model, 4 subtypes were found with homogeneity index Hs=10. Associations between social symptom severity and GMV differed by subtype: greater GMV in frontoparietal regions (subtype1, r=0.29–0.44) and ventral visual pathway (subtype3, r=0.19–0.23), but lower GMV in right ACC (subtype4, r≈−0.25) and select subcortical regions (subtype2, r≈−0.31 to −0.20). Subtyping increased case–control classification accuracy from 0.64 to 0.75 (p<0.05 by permutation), and exceeded k-means-based subtyping (0.68, p<0.01).
clinical_application_and_analysis.key_limitations: Sample size limited due to missing data (noted in abstract); demographic differences across subtypes (age, sex, TIV) required covariate regression in sensitivity analyses; no external validation of normative model.
clinical_application_and_analysis.application_notes: Introduces RFHCC algorithm for subtype discovery using SVD-derived features and homogeneity index; multiple control-matching strategies (EGMAD and matchit); feature importance assessed via eli5.

general_notes.general_notes: Cerebellum and vermis excluded from ROI set; AAL3 atlas used for 140 regions. QC excluded 32 failed segmentations and 31 TIV outliers. Site effects assessed qualitatively via t-SNE on residual PCs suggesting reduced site structure without formal harmonization (no ComBat/HBR).
